**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 29 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 27 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24 [Exorcist](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2787) **Source** [Pathfinder #198: No Breath to Cry](/Sources.aspx?ID=224) pg. 48 **Perception** +16 **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +14, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +16, [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=9) +16, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +15, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +18 **Str** +2 **Dex** +2 **Con** +3 **Int** +1 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +2 **Items** [Hide Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=7), key, _+1 striking [spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=365)_, [Torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60) --- **AC** 24 **Fort** +15 **Ref** +14 **Will** +18 **HP** 135 --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** _spear_ +17 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d6+5 piercing **Melee** torch +16 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)), **Damage** 1d4+5 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 26, attack +18 - **Cantrips (4th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Divine Lance](/Spells.aspx?ID=84), [Produce Flame](/Spells.aspx?ID=236), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286) - **1st** [Bane](/Spells.aspx?ID=18), [Command](/Spells.aspx?ID=45), [Sanctuary](/Spells.aspx?ID=266) - **2nd** [Gentle Repose](/Spells.aspx?ID=131), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Spiritual Weapon](/Spells.aspx?ID=306) - **3rd** [Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Searing Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=269) - **4th** [Divine Wrath](/Spells.aspx?ID=86), [Talking Corpse](/Spells.aspx?ID=329) **Rituals** - **2nd** [Consecrate](/Rituals.aspx?ID=8) **Purifying Flames** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) The exorcist attempts to Strike a creature with their torch, attacking with great precision and causing the torch's fires to flare up. This Strike gains a +2 status bonus to its attack roll and inflicts an additional 2d6 fire damage on a hit instead of just 1d6 fire damage. An undead, spirit, or transmigrated creature hit by this attack must also attempt a DC 26 Will save. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected by this additional effect, and some of the fire flares back onto the exorcist, inflicting 2d6 fire damage to the exorcist (DC 26 basic Reflex save).
**Success** The creature is unaffected by this additional effect.
**Failure** The purifying flames cause the creature to become [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) 1 and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 until the end of its next turn.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but clumsy 2 and stupefied 2 for 1 minute. **Torch Wielder** The exorcist treats a torch as a light mace that deals an additional 1d6 fire damage on a hit.
name: Exorcist
